question: The Almatti Dam of Karnataka is built over which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Krishna** is one of the major rivers in India, originating from the **Western Ghats in Maharashtra and flowing through Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh** before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The Krishna River basin is the third-largest in India, covering an area of about 258,948 square kilometers.
 
• The river is an important source of irrigation, drinking water, and power generation for the states through which it flows.
 
• The Almatti Dam, also known as the Lal Bahadur Shastri Dam, is built across the Krishna River in the state of Karnataka. It is a multipurpose dam used for irrigation, hydroelectric power generation, and flood control.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Periyar is a river in Kerala, originating from the Western Ghats and flowing through the districts of Idukki and Ernakulam before emptying into the Arabian Sea. There is no dam named Almatti on the Periyar River.
 
• Kaveri is a major river in South India, originating from the Brahmagiri hills in Karnataka and flowing through Tamil Nadu and Puducherry before emptying into the Bay of Bengal. The KRS Dam, also known as the Kannambadi-Kaveri Sump, is built across the Kaveri River near Mysuru in Karnataka. There is no dam named Almatti on the Kaveri River.
 
• Sutlej is a river in North India, originating from the Himalayas and flowing through Himachal Pradesh and Punjab before entering Pakistan. There is no dam named Almatti on the Sutlej River.
